description: Read stored review statistics and star distribution for an extension, optionally by review language. These describe collected reviews, not all store ratings. Missing statistics return null; no refresh is triggered.

eid.description: 32-letter Chrome Web Store extension ID (a-p), not a URL, name or slug. Example: cjpalhdlnbpafiamejdnhcphjbkeiagm.

language.description: Original review language, e.g. en; all combines languages. This filters reviews rather than translating the response.

windowDays.description: 0 = all retained reviews; 365 = the stored one-year review window.

name: extension_review_insights
